note: Level 1, The Road to the Kingdom (docs/GAMEPLAY.md). Played by world/dialogue.gd, triggered by world/level_story.gd. Conversations play once; pools repeat (random pick, cooldown in seconds). Opigo is gruff and calls Amodu a mistake; Opumie is warm and funny. Family-friendly.

start: No. No, no, no. That's a mistake.
The potion's gone, old friend. There's no second shot.
We came for the big one. The loud one. Not... this.
I'm standing right here, you know.
Then come on. Our camp's by the pencil, and we need our things.
camp_stone: The giant's stomping brought it down on our camp. Everything we have is under there.
Well, kid? Don't just stand there.
camp_freed: On his own. You were saying?
Grab what you can carry. Then east, to our old rest stop.
stage:crisp_packet: Our old rest stop... Look at it. Torn wide open.
Mud tubes over the trail. Termites? This far north?
Hunters. And where there are hunters, Akpuru isn't far behind.
axe: Kid! You can't fight them with your hands. Here, take this!
It's an axe. The sharp end goes at them.
cut_road_escape: They'll be back, and more of them. We need to get away, fast.
Up your bag, kid. From the top, we fly.
stage:bag_top: That's my school bag. I just climbed my own school bag.
See the red earth in the middle? That's our gate. Home.
And smoke in the south. Termites. Too close to the colony.
Grab a seed puff. Faster than walking, and they can't follow us through the air.
stage:dandelion: Keep your voice down in the grass. Things live here that eat things like us.
stage:daisy_stair: Up the daisies. Mind the pollen, it gets everywhere.
stage:root_hall_door: Root Hall. The colony sealed that door before my grandmother's time.
Wedged tight. A hundred of us couldn't shift it. Keep moving.
Old tunnels. Older stories. Remember it.
stage:orb_web: Web. Walk around it. Don't touch anything.
knife: The silk's too thick for the axe that close to him. Here, my knife. Cut him down!
stage:capstone: The Capstone. Best view in the garden.
Termites. Hundreds of them. That's Akpuru's army.
They're marching on the colony. Run!
gate: Halt! The gate is sealed. Nobody in, nobody out.
It's us, you fool. Opigo and Opumie!
You two can come in. Not that thing.
Queen's orders. The siege has begun.
Then there's another way. The old way!
Root Hall? The colony sealed it for good. It'd take a hundred of us.
dusk: Sun's going. Termites hunt in the dark.
Then let's not be here for it. To the apple tree!
door_ready: Here. The old door. Kid... push.
door_open: He moved it. He actually moved it.

lines: You know what they called us, back in the day? The Musketeers.
Are you sure you know the way?
I've walked this garden since before you were born.
He got lost behind the watering can last spring.
Walk quieter. You stomp like a beetle.
Hungry? There are cake crumbs about. Humans are generous without knowing it.
My mum's going to be so worried.
Then let's get you somewhere safe, and quick.
Three of us went out once. Only two came back.
Put that down before you hurt yourself. ...Fine.
Every time. Every single time, it's still amazing.
Up you get. Heroes don't nap.
A mistake who keeps getting back up.
